API ReferenceZIdentity APIAPI ClientsApiclient Ops Update
Apiclient Ops Update
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/api-clients/:id

Updates the existing API client details based on the provided ID. This allows modification of attributes such as name, authentication settings, and assigned roles.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the API client to be updated.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
name
string
REQUIRED

A descriptive name for the API client.

Possible values: <= 128 characters

description
string

A brief description of the API client.

Possible values: <= 256 characters

status
boolean

Whether the API client needs to be active (true) or disabled (false).

accessTokenLifeTime
int32
REQUIRED

Update the lifetime (in minutes) of the access token issued to this API client. Example: 60 for 60 minutes.

Possible values: >= 60 and <= 86400

clientAuthentication
object
REQUIRED
clientResources
object[]
REQUIRED
Responses
​
200
500

The request was successful, and the API client details are updated.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
name
string
REQUIRED

The name of the OAuth2 client.

Possible values: <= 128 characters

description
string

A description of the client.

Possible values: <= 256 characters

status
boolean

Whether the client is active (true) or inactive (false).

accessTokenLifeTime
int32
REQUIRED

Specifies how long (in seconds) the access token remains valid.

Possible values: >= 60 and <= 86400

clientAuthentication
object
REQUIRED
clientResources
object[]
REQUIRED
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the OAuth2 client.
